Profile

Sergi Valverde, PhD

Sergi Valverde is a CSIC Tenured Scientist at the Institute of Evolutionary Biology (CSIC–UPF), Barcelona, where he leads the Evolution of Networks Laboratory. His research combines network theory, statistical physics, mathematical and computational modelling, and empirical analysis to investigate the organization and evolutionary dynamics of complex systems. Across biological, cultural and technological systems, he studies how interactions, structural constraints and processes operating across scales shape persistence, innovation and evolutionary transitions.

s.valverde@csic.es · Institutional profile · Evolution of Networks Laboratory · ORCID: 0000-0002-2150-9610 · Google Scholar
